name: orbit-handoff
description: Set up token-efficient coding continuity and carry verified state between sessions.

interface.longDescription: Orbit Handoff adds two local coding skills. Orbit Setup prepares a project with lightweight living PRODUCT, DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and ROADMAP documents plus token-efficient agent rules for selective context loading, bounded subagents and durable checkpoints. Orbit Handoff then overwrites a local HANDOFF-STATE.md with verified current state, decisions, risks and next steps at meaningful checkpoints and completed tasks. Handoffs are capped at 50 lines, validated before atomic replacement and kept separate from tracked project history. The handoff writer makes no network calls or Git mutations. Setup preserves existing docs and unrelated instructions.
defaultPrompt: Set up this coding project for efficient continuity, or save the verified current state at a meaningful checkpoint.

publication.release_notes: Orbit Setup adds lightweight living project docs and token-efficient agent rules. Handoff can now be invoked automatically at configured meaningful checkpoints and completed tasks.
